sections.title: Letter efe sound
paragraphs: The letter (efe) /ˈefe/ makes the sound /f/. You hear it in the word (fuego) /ˈfwe.ɣo/, which means fire. This letter has only one sound in Spanish.

sections.title: Pronouncing the letter
paragraphs: Rest your upper teeth lightly against your lower lip. Push air out gently between your teeth and lip. Keep your vocal cords still so you make no humming voice. Place a hand on your throat to feel that it does not buzz.

sections.title: Reading the letter
paragraphs: The letter always makes the sound /f/ in all positions. You hear this sound clearly in the word (café) /kaˈfe/.

sections.title: Tips for speakers
paragraphs: This sound matches the normal sound in the English word fish. There is no real pitfall with this Spanish letter.
